If you can pull the job off, the Saints will have more contracts for you down the line.

1b5zdeo.description_en: Our partners at [LOCATION] need help. A rival outlaw crew are swarming the area and attacking the [OBJECTS] there. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site is absolutely critical to our future plans in the area and its damn important that it remains in working order. With the scale of this attack and the skill of these pilots, there's no doubt that some reliable backup would serve you well. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and stop these bootlicks before they can do any lasting damage. To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn 9 Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong. - Stow

我们在 [LOCATION] 的合作伙伴需要帮忙。一伙敌对的不法分子正蜂拥而至，袭击那里的 [OBJECTS]。这本身就够糟糕了，但这处地点对我们未来的区域计划至关重要，必须得让它保持正常运转。

这次攻击规模不小，这些飞行员也身手不凡，毫无疑问，找些靠谱的帮手会对你大有帮助。召集你的人马，飞到现场，在那些马屁精造成永久性破坏之前把他们拦下来。

为了证明我们对此事绝不马虎，只要确保万无一失，主承包商就能拿到 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为奖励。

- 斯托斯

1ymhfaf.description_en:
Hello,
Looking for a quick job? Got a client who's waiting on a shipment but our hauler ran into some engine trouble. Can't seem to get them up and running so we need someone to take over.
Fly out to [LOCATION] and you'll spot their ship. You can't miss it - it's the one that's sitting still in the middle of space. Make sure you bring a heavy-duty tractor beam along with a decent ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Once you've picked up the goods take them to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

你好，

请飞往 [LOCATION]，他们的飞船一眼就能认出，就是那艘孤零零停在太空中央的那个。务必带上重型牵引光束，以及一艘能装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的靠谱飞船。

取货后，将货物送至 [DESTINATION] 处的货运电梯。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any friendly ships unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you.
Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor 3 Council Scrip just to show my appreciation.
Stows out.
pgyzd0.description_zh:
我过得很糟，今天更是雪上加霜。我们位于 [LOCATION] 的利益相关方发来消息，称他们的 [OBJECTS] 正遭到一群无名小卒的攻击，对方企图抢占地盘。

你得去那里替我保护好该区域，包括任何不幸卷入交火的友方飞船。对于像你这样的人来说，教训这些半吊子应该不算什么难事。

此外，为了表达我的谢意，我将向主承包商额外支付 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

I'm so mad right now I can barely see straight. A Headhunter who I thought I could trust just went over to the XenoThreat. Yeah, aliens killed your family. Shit sucks, but you don't turn your back on your people.
To add insult to injury, the bastard gave XenoThreat a bunch of our intel. I have some other folks tracking the traitor down, but I need you to take care of wiping out the stolen data for me. It's being kept on servers at [LOCATION].
-Stows out

我现在气得眼睛都看不清楚了。一个我本以为可以信任的猎头帮成员居然叛变了，投向了异种威胁。没错，外星人杀了你的家人，这真让人糟心，但你总不能背叛自己的同胞。

更让人恼火的是，这家伙居然把我们的一些情报交给了异种威胁。我让其他人去追踪这个叛徒，但我需要你帮我清除被盗的数据。那些数据存储在 [LOCATION] 的服务器上。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager.
Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.

- A handheld tractor beam
> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

Some numskull flying a [TARGET] was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size.
Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

“您的货物，有我保障”

pkcqs5.description_en:
This’ll be a fun one for you. We just got word that a transport ship has broken down at [LOCATION]. Only problem is, every skag and their mother seems to know about it. Place is crawling with all kinds of outlaws trying to get their hands on the cargo onboard. That’s where you come in.
If you can get your best pilots together and a heavy-duty tractor beam you can take out the competition and snag the cargo. It ain’t gonna be easy though. One of my scouts said the assholes guarding this ship have got some serious tech on them.
I’ve already got a buyer waiting, you just need to take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll send you the creds.
Stows out.
pkcqs5.description_zh:
这对你来说会是个有趣的任务。我们刚收到消息，有一艘运输船在 [LOCATION] 那儿抛锚了。问题在于，好像所有的不法分子都知道这件事。那儿到处都是想抢走船上货物的混蛋。这就是你需要发挥作用的地方。

如果你能召集你最厉害的飞行员，并且准备好重型牵引光束，那么你就能击败那些对手拿到货物。不过这不会容易的。我的一个侦察员说，守着那艘船的家伙们有一些很厉害的装备。

我已经找好了买家，你只需要把货物送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，我就会把报酬给你。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

尤金·沃尔顿

For any pilots in the area – a group of bandits is targeting one of our clients at [LOCATION], specifically their [OBJECTS] and the maintenance ships that manage them.
